title: Step-Through Pass Around a Defender
description: A defender stands between partners with active hands; the passer pivots and steps through to pass around the defender's hands instead of over or through them.

content.objective: Create a passing angle under pressure by pivoting and stepping past the defender's hip, then passing around the hands.
content.setup: Groups of three: passer and receiver five metres apart, a defender pressuring the passer.
instructions: The passer holds the ball after a jump stop; the defender guards with hands up.
Fake high to raise the defender's hands.
Pivot and step through low beside the defender's hip.
Deliver a one-hand bounce or push pass past the hip to the receiver.
The receiver returns the ball to the passer and play continues.
coachingPoints: Fake one way, pass the other.
Step past the defender's hip, not toward the defender's chest.
Pass from the hip with one hand.
commonMistakes: Lob passes over the defender that hang in the air.
Dragging the pivot foot on the step-through.
Passing straight into the defender's hands.
content.safety: Defenders play the ball, not the passer's arms; no slapping.
progressions: Defender may move and use full pressure.
Receiver is also guarded and must get open.
regressions: Defender keeps hands still in a fixed position.
variations: Overhead pass after a low fake.
Pass with the weak hand only.
successCriteria: 6 of 8 passes reach the receiver untouched.
content.gameApplication: Passers in traffic, especially after a stopped dribble, need the step-through to find teammates.
